symptom: Git hook or script pointing directly into target/ fails after cargo clean or target directory wipe
signature: target/(release|debug)/do-harness: No such file or directory
fix_hint: Do not point git hooks directly at target/ binaries. Install the binary via cargo install --path or put it in PATH (~/.local/bin).

symptom: Shell script fails under POSIX dash with illegal option -o pipefail
fix_hint: POSIX sh (/bin/sh on Debian/Ubuntu, dash) does not support pipefail. Use #!/usr/bin/env bash if pipefail is required, or remove pipefail from POSIX sh scripts.

symptom: npm publish fails with HTTP 403 Forbidden on win32 platform package due to npm registry name screening
fix_hint: npm registry name screening rejects do-harness-win32-x64 with 403 Forbidden. Declare it in UNAVAILABLE_PKGS to skip direct publishing while preserving the meta package optionalDependency pin.

symptom: Git hooks in .git/hooks or .do-harness/ do not execute because core.hooksPath overrides them
fix_hint: Git's core.hooksPath configuration overrides repository-local .git/hooks. Unset core.hooksPath with 'git config --unset core.hooksPath' or configure the hook runner in that path.

symptom: commitlint fails on shallow clones or initial commit because HEAD~1..HEAD revision range is invalid
fix_hint: The commit history range HEAD~1..HEAD does not exist in a shallow clone or initial commit. Fetch full depth with 'git fetch --unshallow' or update check-commitlint.sh to handle empty history.
